crossRefs.note: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed; and hidden that will not be…
What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,
Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of…
that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge…
for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

parallels.note: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

translations.web: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
translations.bsb: Pray that I may declare it clearly, as I should.
translations.kjv: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
